'''Rombuk''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] used as mounts around [[3627 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rombuk appear in the [[2019]]'s sixth expansion to the videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', called [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']]. They were awarded as mounts in Season 12 PvP.
